title: fak engine — continuous batching cycle
description: Native in-kernel serving loop, one continuous-batching cycle end to end (fak_engine_* on job fak_gateway). Missing data is Unavailable, never zero.

panels.title: Native engine: one continuous-batching cycle, in request-flow order

options.content: Step recorder of the native in-kernel serving loop (`fak_engine_*`, job `fak_gateway`). Rows follow one request through the cycle: **admission wait -> device wait -> cohort forming -> prefix lookup -> chunked prefill -> prefix admit -> decode steps (serial or batched) -> sampling -> request done**. Bounded JSON view of the same recorder: `/v1/fak/engine/steps`. **Unavailable means missing evidence**, not zero: an absent series means the engine did not report it.

panels.title: Overview: is the engine stepping, and how full are the batches?
Seconds since last step
panels.description: Liveness of the stepping loop: seconds since the last prefill chunk or decode step. Unavailable means the engine has never stepped (timestamp 0).

panels.title: Requests active
panels.description: Requests currently inside the native planner (admitted, in any phase of the cycle).

panels.title: Coalescer queue depth
panels.description: Batch-forming step: requests waiting in the decode coalescer for the next cohort.

panels.title: Scheduler running / waiting
panels.description: Admission step: requests running vs. waiting in the gateway admission scheduler.

panels.title: Decode tokens/s
panels.description: Decode step throughput: tokens advanced by decode steps per second, all paths.

panels.title: Mean batch size
panels.description: Decode step: mean active lanes advanced per decode step (rate of lanes sum / rate of step count), all paths. 1 means no batching benefit.

panels.title: Admission & queueing: waits before a request reaches the device
Scheduler occupancy
panels.description: Admission step: requests running and waiting in the gateway scheduler.

panels.title: Scheduler tokens
panels.description: Admission step: KV tokens in use by running requests vs. tokens queued behind admission.

panels.title: Wait latency p50 / p99
panels.description: Admission wait, device-lock wait, and coalescer cohort wait per request, p50 and p99 by phase.

panels.title: Admission outcomes/s
panels.description: Admission step outcomes: requests admitted, queued, or shed per second.

panels.title: Serving running / waiting
panels.description: Admission step, serving-layer view: requests running vs. waiting.

panels.title: Batch forming: cohorts and decode batch size
Cohort size
panels.description: Batch-forming step: lanes per decode cohort formed by the coalescer (p50, p99, mean).

panels.title: Cohorts formed/s
panels.description: Batch-forming step: decode cohorts started per second by the coalescer.

panels.title: Coalescer queue depth over time
panels.description: Batch-forming step: requests waiting in the decode coalescer over time.

panels.title: Decode batch size p50 / p99 by path
panels.description: Decode step batch size: lanes advanced by one decode step, by path (serial = 1 lane via Session.Step, batched = N lanes via StepBatchActive).

panels.title: Decode batch size distribution
panels.description: Decode step batch size distribution over time (all paths); each band is a lanes bucket (le).

panels.title: Prefill: prompt forward and prefix cache
Prefill tokens/s and chunks/s
panels.description: Prefill step: prompt tokens forwarded per second (excludes prefix hits) and prefill chunks executed per second.

panels.title: Tokens per prefill chunk
panels.description: Prefill step: mean prompt tokens forwarded per chunk (chunked-prefill granularity).

panels.title: Prefix-matched tokens/s
panels.description: Prefix lookup step: prompt tokens served from the KV prefix cache instead of prefill.

panels.title: Prefix hit share
panels.description: Prefix lookup step: share of prompt tokens served from the prefix cache = matched / (matched + prefilled); serving-layer prefix hit rate for comparison.

panels.title: Prefill-stage latency p50 / p99
panels.description: Prefix lookup, prefill forward, and prefix admit duration per request, p50 and p99 by phase.

panels.title: KV cache usage
panels.description: Prefix admit step lands the prompt in the KV cache: serving-layer KV cache usage.

panels.title: Decode steps: forward, sample, per-request decode
Decode steps/s by path
panels.description: Decode step: forward steps executed per second, by path (serial vs. batched).

panels.title: Decode step latency p50 / p99 by path
panels.description: Decode step: wall time of one decode forward, by path.

panels.title: Decode tokens/s by path
panels.description: Decode step: tokens advanced per second by path; gateway completion tokens/s for comparison.

panels.title: Sample latency p50 / p99
panels.description: Sample step: logits -> token id time per token.

panels.title: Decode per request p50 / p99
panels.description: Decode loop: one request's whole decode (all of its steps).

panels.title: End to end: request latency and where time goes
Request latency p50 / p99
panels.description: Request done: one request end to end inside the planner.

panels.title: Where time goes (phase seconds per second)
panels.description: Whole cycle: seconds spent per second in each phase (stacked, request excluded). The widest band is the phase dominating the cycle.

panels.title: Gateway token rates
panels.description: End to end: prompt and completion tokens/s reported by the gateway for the same traffic.

panels.title: Eviction: scheduler preemption, shedding, and KV pressure
Preemptions/s by mode
panels.description: KV-block exhaustion: sequences preempted per second, split by swap-to-host vs. drop-and-recompute (fak_sched_preempt_total, _swap_total, _recompute_total).

panels.title: Prefix-cache evictions/s by kind
panels.description: Radix KV prefix-cache evictions per second by cause: LRU pressure vs. policy/quarantine (fak_gateway_kv_memory_evictions_total{kind}; gateway-liveness joined).

panels.title: Completions/s by finish reason
panels.description: Requests finishing per second, split by finish_reason (fak_gateway_inference_requests_total; gateway-liveness joined).

panels.title: Resident KV bytes
panels.description: Gateway-level resident local KV-cache bytes derived from prefix positions and model KV geometry (fak_gateway_kv_memory_resident_bytes; gateway-liveness joined). This is the cache-edge residency, not a per-engine-step byte count: no enginestep family exposes per-step KV bytes.
